input_admission.source_units: Mi has explicit 2272 mm wheelbase; body-value unit millimetres follows sheet context. CH units are interpreted from scale/context.

preferred_contact_set.side_sign: plus/minus are mathematical side placeholders only, not established donor left/right or driver/passenger. Label actual physical side from vehicle context; do not infer steering side.
preferred_contact_set.contact: Centre of each of four 25 x 34 mm apertures F/G. Source drawing provides a centreline and datum line.
preferred_contact_set.x_basis: F chosen as 0; G lies 1245 rearward along projected chain.
preferred_contact_set.y_basis: Half of combined equal-sided spans 1330 at F and 1236 at G; no measured donor symmetry assumed.
preferred_contact_set.z_basis: F 152 / G 156 above printed source datum line; physical setup and which aperture-mouth plane was contacted are unresolved.
why_preferred: Explicit named aperture centres with nominal size, unlike generic body silhouettes or gap loops.
Two longitudinal stations and two lateral sides span roughly 1.25 m by 1.3 m.
Does not depend on C strut stud or B width; no bracket selection needed.
Holes are fixed body features rather than tyre, suspension or removable cover surfaces.
preferred_contact_set.geometry_qualification: Source F/G are fixed-body candidates by depicted underbody context; exact donor body feature identity must be observed.

rigid_transform_constraints.transform_kind: 6 DOF proper rigid transform only after unit/scale status is admitted; no scale, shear, mirroring or warp optimisation.
rigid_transform_constraints.minimum_exact_configuration: Three correctly labelled non-collinear complete 3D contacts determine one proper rigid transform once handedness/physical-side orientation is fixed.
rigid_transform_constraints.recommended_fit: All four independently observed F/G centres, with full six-distance pre-fit check, uncertainty weighting once supported and redundant residuals.
rigid_transform_constraints.missing_contact_rule: With fewer than three non-collinear complete 3D contacts, no full 3D transform. Three contacts can produce a numerical study only; acquire redundant contacts and independent checks before registration admission.
rigid_transform_constraints.coplanarity_consequence: F/G establish an in-plane pattern but cannot independently validate off-plane geometry. Fix front/rear, physical side and underside/upward-normal context before fitting to reject symmetric alternative correspondences.
rigid_transform_constraints.holdout_requirement: At least one separately identified off-plane named contact and a further unused body-contact or distance check. Prefer independent observations spanning front/rear. Never count fit residuals or closure identities as held-out measurements.

candidate_holdouts.source: Mi A lower front bumper bolt head
candidate_holdouts.status: candidate if exact lower bolt head visible and assembled state established; rear point A/J 5 mm source conflicts remain external comparison, not error tolerance

candidate_holdouts.source: Mi J lower rear bumper bolt head
candidate_holdouts.status: candidate if exact bolt head visible; not absorber-tube centre

candidate_holdouts.source: Mi D/E/H bolt heads or corresponding bare-frame contacts
candidate_holdouts.status: lower-height independent checks available; choose exactly matching assembly state, never mix bolt and frame heights

candidate_holdouts.source: Mi I rear motor-mount bolt head
candidate_holdouts.status: good off-plane geometry if source-named rear bolt physically visible; half-width 320 from Mi4 E/D cross-figure span 640; underneath visibility unproved

candidate_holdouts.source: Mi C front inner strut stud tip
candidate_holdouts.status: not a complete 3D control: width unresolved and typically above underside acquisition

acceptance_limits.reason: Define justified interface-specific limits before approving registration; source rounded closure residuals and old tyre-frame scatter do not supply tolerances.

required_per_candidate: Unchanged original scan hash plus exact source triangle and vertex IDs for its local patch.
Annotated overall underside view showing front/rear and physical left/right; local oblique and normal-to-aperture views.
Visible full rim or sufficient opposing rim evidence; original-open versus selection-cut boundary classification; no completed or interpolated rim.
Surrounding fixed-body context, folds/rail/jacking reinforcement and seams supporting physical correspondence independently of target coordinates.
Aperture size/directions observed from scan with justified localisation/scale uncertainty; assess 25 x 34 nominal likeness after identifying the feature.

Defined measured point: centre construction, supporting observed rim entities, selected mouth/rim plane, ambiguity in contact depth and propagation. Hole axis and hidden opposite face remain separate unknowns.
Assembly state: present bolt heads, removed components, plugs, sealant and detachable cover cannot be exchanged with bare body features.
All plausible candidates in the region, reasons for exclusions and independent reviewer acceptance; never choose only the nearest nominal residual.
reject_or_defer_if: The region is an empty point cloud, view-dependent silhouette, trimming boundary or mesh repair.
The open loop is merely a source gap/occlusion or part identity cannot be shown.
Only one side is observed and the other is fabricated by symmetry.
The visible object is a cover, rubber plug, jack pad, arm, gearbox or other assembly rather than the named body aperture.
The point is a stud tip, bolt head or seating face different from the source contact.
A source bracket, date family or contact state is selected only because it yields the smallest fit error.

findings: Fourteen matched heights admit the numerical candidate z_Mi = z_Other + 50 mm; this does not establish physical datum setup.
Mi I maps candidate Other J and Mi J maps Other I; letters cannot be copied.
Front/rear bumper X differ 5 mm; G width differs 1 mm per side even after choosing bracketed Other value.
Other F/G bracket shifts could be centre/edge-related, but legend remains absent. Do not select brackets to fit scan.

Mi_to_CH.status: no common transform or contact equivalence established

candidate_only_pairs.comparisons: CH X 514 from 5; Mi B-A 527. Y CH 305 versus Mi B unknown. Heights 151/209 versus Mi 167/237 do not share one offset across states.
Both half-width 385; heights 147/219 versus Mi 164/246 give different 17/27 offsets. X 873 from CH 5 versus 884 from Mi A.
Half-width 217 versus 218; heights 127/149 versus Mi 151/187 give 24/38 offsets. No exact physical identity proved.

Mi_to_CH.required_next: Use CH independently only after exact graphical tool/contact and assembly state observed; keep parts-on and parts-removed networks separate. CH point numbers are not Porsche manual IDs or Mi letters.

known_from_records: Original underside scan has 4684929 triangles and 118411 open edges; assembled body/mechanical components overlap.
Existing tyre-derived vehicle frame is provisional.
The largest floor/central-cover observations share a 3765948-face component; mesh connectedness does not identify a vehicle part.
An original open edge may be an acquisition gap, occlusion or physical rim; selection cut boundaries are artificial.
Prior rear upper/P14 review did not identify defensible body-mount centres; no source-sheet match supplies that missing observation.
Interior tunnel, upper cell, hidden surfaces, thickness and functional axes remain unobserved.

open_questions_resolvable_from_current_s: Mi I source-local half-width 320 is supported by matching rear motor-mount bolt names in Mi3 and Mi4 E/D span 640.
Mi B/C widths remain absent/unadmitted; Other supplies candidates 612/858 but source contact reconciliation is insufficient for automatic import.
Mi F/G aperture dimensions and combined-width convention are already explicit; their correspondence to manual P17/P18 remains a physical-feature question rather than a missing scalar.
